scenes.text: The core rule is permission. Only the customer can tick the box, and it's never pre-ticked. Without it, approval is refused. And if they withdraw, the quote leaves the wall right away.

The surprises were in the gaps. A second moderator could silently replace the featured quote. And a quote starting with an equals sign could run as a formula in the CSV export. All eleven are now fixed.
So is it worth building? Senja's free plan hides new testimonials after fifteen, and Starter is twenty-nine dollars a month. If you only need the form, the permission and the wall, build it.
